criteria.text: `graphFor`/`sourcesFor`/`docsFor` given `source: 'gnews,rss,gkg'` count only docs whose `source` is `gnews`, `rss`, or `gkg` — checked by a fixture-backed test asserting `stats.docs`/`stats.about`/`total` against a hand-counted expectation.
Given `source: 'gnews,bogus'`, the three functions above produce results identical to `source: 'gnews'` — unknown token silently dropped, checked by comparing two calls.
Given `source: 'bogus1,bogus2'` (every token invalid), results are identical to `source: 'all'` — checked by comparing two calls.

Given `source: ''` or `source` omitted, both produce results identical to `source: 'all'` — checked by comparing calls (already partly covered for the omitted case by existing tests; add the empty-string case).

Given a single valid token (`source: 'bluesky'`), behavior is byte-for-byte the same as before this change — the existing "filters by source and by domain" test in `graph.test.ts:52-58` passes unmodified.

`parseSourceList`, exported from `server.ts`, returns `'all'` for `undefined`, `''`, `'all'`, and `'bogus'`; returns `'gnews'` for `'gnews'` and for `'gnews,bogus'`; returns `'gnews,rss'` for `'gnews,rss'` and for `'gnews,rss,gnews'` (dedup) — unit-tested in a new `test/server.test.ts`.

Mixing a GDELT and a non-GDELT source in one list (`gnews,rss,gkg`) yields a non-null `tone` only for terms whose docs include the `gkg` doc, and `null` tone for terms found only in `gnews`/`rss` docs — checked with the new fixture `gkg` doc.

In `public/design-5.html`, checking "imprensa × rede" shows two columns and fires two `/graph` requests, one with `source=gnews,rss,gkg` and one with `source=bluesky`, both carrying the same `days`/`kind`/`sort`/`limit`/`min`/`domain` as the toolbar's current shared state — manual check via the browser network tab.
While split mode is active, `#segSource` is disabled and changing `dias`, `tipo`, `ordem`, `nós`, or `mín. docs` refetches both columns with the new shared value — manual check.
Unchecking "imprensa × rede" returns to the single radial atlas exactly as it rendered before split mode was entered, with `#segSource` re-enabled — manual check.

A term id present in both columns' node lists shows the gold marker in both places; a term id present in only one column shows no marker — manual check, cross-referenced against the two responses' node id sets in devtools.

Clicking a term row in the right ("rede") column opens the doc panel showing only docs with `source: "bluesky"`; clicking a row in the left ("imprensa") column shows only docs with `source` in `{gnews, rss, gkg}` — manual check.

A column with no matching docs in the current window shows the same empty-state copy as the single-atlas `#empty` div, and does not block the other column from rendering — manual check (e.g. narrow `dias` to a window where one side is empty).
